prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a preschool listening picture-card game
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only; match its flat picture-book rendering, warm pale background, rounded shapes, color polish, and smooth navy outline weight, but do not copy any animal.
Primary request: create one polished wide 3:2 illustration sheet containing exactly six isolated food picture-card subjects in this exact left-to-right row order.
Scene/backdrop: one uniform warm pale cream background across the whole sheet, with broad empty gutters separating every cell.
Subject: top row, left to right: one red apple; one yellow banana; one orange carrot with a small leafy top. Bottom row, left to right: one whole orange fruit with one small green leaf; one single loaf of bread; one single yellow wedge of cheese.
Style/medium: consistent flat picture-book illustration for young children; simple rounded shapes; clean solid color fills; subtle paper-like softness; strong smooth navy outlines of equal visual weight.
Composition/framing: rigid 3-column by 2-row grid on a wide 3:2 canvas; six equal cells; each subject fully contained, isolated, centered, similarly scaled, and surrounded by generous breathing room; clear empty separation and outer margins; no subject crosses a cell boundary.
Lighting/mood: bright, gentle, cheerful, calm.
Constraints: exactly one named food item per cell and exactly six main subjects total; preserve the exact ordering; no words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, divider text, logos, signatures, or watermark; no people; no hands holding food; no faces on food; no plates, bowls, baskets, utensils, tables, crumbs, sliced pieces, ground lines, scenes, props, or extra food; no cell borders that touch a subject.
Avoid: ambiguity between the orange fruit and the carrot; duplicate foods; food groups or piles; cropped subjects; adjacent-cell leakage; photorealism; 3D rendering; clutter; artifacts.
